meta.title: Recreate Order: Cancel button closes the Recreate Order window without creating an order
gaps: Whether cancelling created no new order on the RFQ detail page
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether cancelling created no new order on the RFQ detail page

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the bid and stage actions are available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window has closed.
Verify that the buyer remains on the RFQ detail summary rather than being taken to a created order.
